## Project Overview
ChronoSentiment — a deterministic financial replay and strategy identity verification system. Project root: `/Users/nikhil/ChronoSentiment_MEGA_FINAL`. Version bumped to 0.2.0. Phase 0D (cross-architecture replay identity verification) is complete and certified.

## Completed Work
1. Captured Host A (ARM64 macOS) baseline package
2. Set up UTM + Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS AMD64 VM (0D-A)
3. Installed build deps and Rust 1.91.1 in VM
4. Cloned repo at commit `1eebebef8cbbb53aacdd22237945195b41260de0` in VM
5. Transferred and verified chronology files in VM
6. Captured Host B environment (git, toolchain, uname)
7. Built `financial_replay` binary in VM
8. Ran SPY replay in VM and verified hash
9. Ran GDAXI replay in VM and verified hash
10. Closed 0D-A — wrote `host_b_0da_result.md`
11. Ran same package on Raspberry Pi 5 (0D-B) — built, ran SPY and GDAXI, wrote `host_c_0db_result.md`
12. Conducted constitutional audit of all uncommitted changes across 7 files

## Key Technical Decisions
- Phase 0D verified hash-identical replay outputs across 3 hosts: Host A (ARM64 macOS), 0D-A (AMD64 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS in UTM VM), 0D-B (aarch64 Raspberry Pi 5). Scope is replay identity reproducibility only — bit-identical binaries not claimed.
- Rust toolchain pinned at `1.91.1` for cross-arch reproducibility
- Canonical schemas define all data contracts; UI components must source data through them
- `differential_report.json` is a **generated artifact** — must not be hand-edited; produced by `write_differential_report()` in `verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` using `sorted(PARSERS)` keys
- `verify_chronology_byte_fixtures.py` `--strict` flag: default behavior was changed to exit 0 on mismatch without `--strict` (constitutional concern — weakens default)
- `generate_release_manifest.sh` grep pattern changed from `"verified"` to `"[PASS]"` — coordinated with `verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` empty-dir handling change (exit 0 + `[PASS]` for empty fixture dir)

## Relevant Files & Code
- `financial/ese/Cargo.toml` — bumped to `0.2.0`; added `axum 0.7`, `tower 0.4`, `tower-http 0.5` (cors), `uuid 1` (v4); registered `live_observatory` example
- `README.md` — bumped to `0.2.0`; added Phase 0D section with verified hashes table and 3-host verification table
- `docs/ui/uiux.md` — bumped to `1.1`; added StrategyInspector and ComparisonPanels constitutional compliance docs
- `fixtures/strategy_identity/differential_report.json` — **recently modified (hand-edited)**; parser source paths changed to short forms (`core/...`, `services/api/...`) inconsistent with PARSERS registry in `verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` which uses `infrastructure/...` paths; `API_PARSER` path changed from `infrastructure/observatory/api/...` to `services/api/...` — a different path entirely
- `infrastructure/core/chronology/live_capture_0001_manifest.json` — updated to newer capture window (timestamps advanced to 2026-05-28), `chronology_hash` updated, `segments_verified` and `byte_hash_verified` flags added
- `scripts/generate_release_manifest.sh` — added `branch` and `dirty` fields; changed grep from `"verified"` to `"[PASS]"`
- `scripts/verify_chronology_byte_fixtures.py` — added `--strict` flag; without it, exits 0 even on hash mismatches (constitutional concern)
- `scripts/verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` — empty fixture dir now exits 0 with `[PASS]`; added binary existence/version check; added `subprocess` import
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/StrategyInspector.js` — React component; fetches artifact from `/api/replay/{id}/artifact`, does server-side hash verification via POST to `/api/replay/{id}/verify-hash`, WebSocket live updates on `ws://localhost:8080/ws/replay/{id}`, renders tick timeline
- `my-chrono-sentiment-ui/src/components/ComparisonPanels.js` — React component; client-side diff is display-only (not used for hash verification or certification), noted in code comment
- `schemas/canonical/replay_response.schema.json` — defines required fields: `replay_id`, `ticker`, `topology`, `cognition`, `ticks_processed`, `replay_hash` (64-char hex), `timestamp_utc`; optional `ticks` array with `timestamp_utc`, `price`, `volume`
- `schemas/canonical/observatory_state.schema.json` — open in editor
- `schemas/canonical/governor_telemetry.schema.json` — open in editor

## Current Status
User asked "I want the document that explains this" (referring to the core/infra/domain separation). A `find` command is running to locate all `.md` files containing keywords like "infrastructure", "core", "domain", "separation", "module", "boundary", "layer" — awaiting results to identify the architecture governance document(s).

## Pending Tasks
- **ACTIVE**: Awaiting terminal output from `find . -path ./target -prune -o ... -name "*.md" -print | xargs grep -l -i "infrastructure|core|domain|..."` to identify the architecture document(s) that define module/layer separation
- Resolve constitutional issue in `fixtures/strategy_identity/differential_report.json`: either regenerate via `python3 scripts/verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` (restores `infrastructure/...` paths) or update PARSERS constants in `verify_strategy_identity_fixtures.py` if source files have actually moved
